description: The 27.5" Kent Jiro is the ultimate off-road machine for adventurers who seek adventure and want to conquer every trail with ease. Designed to tackle even the tough terrains, Jiro is perfect for mountain bikers of all skill levels. Built with a aluminum full suspension frame, is lightweight and nimble on the trails. The front suspension fork ensures that the rider experiences a smooth ride, and the dual mechanical disc brakes provide reliable stopping power. The 21 speed drivetrain provides plenty of gearing range and you can effortlessly switch gears with the flick of your wrist. The knobby mountain bike tires and lightweight alloy wheels provide excellent traction, stability and handling. The saddle is height adjustable and features a quick-release seat post, allowing riders to quickly and easily adjust their riding position for maximum comfort. With its bold blue color and eye-catching orange and black accents, the Kent Jiro is sure to turn heads on the trails. Whether you're a seasoned mountain biker or a beginner, this bike is guaranteed to provide an exciting and thrilling ride.

components.description: Adjustable Seat Post with Quick Release
